claims.text: Builds smart forms, high-converting quizzes, and booking flows without code

quote.text: Build Smart Forms, High-Converting Quizzes, and Booking Flows Without Code

claims.text: Replaces separate form, quiz, booking and calculator tools with one builder

quote.text: FormDesigner replaces them with one no-code builder, powered by conditional logic and AI

claims.text: Must redeem codes within 60 days of purchase

quote.text: You must redeem your code(s) within 60 days of purchase

claims.text: All-in-one data collection ecosystem vs basic form builders

quote.text: Unlike basic form builders that only handle simple text inputs, FormDesigner is an all-in-one data collection ecosystem.

claims.text: Can build quiz funnels, booking schedules, and pricing calculators in one interface

quote.text: In a single interface, you can build conversational quiz funnels, automated client booking schedules, and advanced interactive pricing calculators using a powerful math formula engine.

claims.text: Offers custom CSS/JS injection and white-label capabilities

quote.text: Combined with deep custom CSS/JS injection and white-label capabilities, it gives you the flexibility of a custom-coded web app without the overhead

claims.text: Conditional logic, branching, payments and math engine are visual drag-and-drop

quote.text: Features like conditional logic, multi-step branching, multi-currency payment collection (via Stripe/PayPal), and the math formula engine are completely visual and use an intuitive drag-and-drop interface.

claims.text: Supports custom CSS and JavaScript for power users and agencies

quote.text: For power users and agencies, we also support custom CSS and JavaScript to push design and tracking boundaries even further

claims.text: AI assistant generates forms, quizzes and flows in under 60 seconds

quote.text: We have introduced a powerful AI assistant that lets you generate fully functional multi-step forms, targeted quizzes, and structured data collection flows from scratch in under 60 seconds.

claims.text: AI handles layout, field selection and basic structure from text prompt

quote.text: Just type in a simple text prompt describing what you need, and the AI will handle the layout, field selection, and basic structure for you.

claims.text: Native integrations with Sheets, Calendar, Mailchimp, Notion, Telegram, Trello and CRMs

quote.text: We support direct native integrations with Google Sheets, Google Calendar, Mailchimp, Notion, Telegram, Trello, and various CRM platforms.

claims.text: Webhooks and Zapier sync data with thousands of apps

quote.text: Additionally, you can use our robust Webhooks or connect via Zapier to sync your data instantly with thousands of other third-party marketing and automation apps.

claims.text: Can pull dynamic data from Sheets, Notion, MySQL and PostgreSQL

quote.text: You can pull data dynamically into your form fields from external data sources like Google Sheets, Notion databases, or MySQL and PostgreSQL databases.

finePrint.summary: A lifetime-deal buyer could have the contract terms changed at any time without notice.

quote.text: The Executor reserves the right to amend or supplement these Terms at any time, with or without notice to the Clients.

finePrint.summary: A lifetime-deal buyer is not protected from future price increases because pricing can be changed unilaterally.

quote.text: The Executor reserves the right to unilaterally change the Price List.

finePrint.summary: A lifetime-deal buyer could lose or see changed features because functionality can be updated at the vendor's sole discretion.

quote.text: The Executor has the right to update the content, functionality and user interface of the Service at any time in its sole discretion.

finePrint.summary: A lifetime-deal buyer could have the agreement ended by the vendor on 10 business days notice.

quote.text: By the Executor at any time with prior notice to the Customer at least 10 (ten) business days prior to the termination.

finePrint.summary: A lifetime-deal buyer risks permanent data loss because all customer data can be deleted one month after termination.

quote.text: After 1 (one) calendar month from the date of termination of the Contract, the Executor is released from any obligations related to Customer Data and has the right to delete all customer data from the Service without the possibility of recovery.

finePrint.summary: A lifetime-deal buyer should expect possible downtime because the vendor can suspend the service for scheduled and emergency maintenance.

quote.text: Suspend the work of the Service to carry out the necessary scheduled preventive and repair work on the technical resources of the Executor, as well as unscheduled work in emergency situations.

finePrint.summary: A lifetime-deal buyer is only promised 90% monthly availability, not full uninterrupted uptime.

quote.text: Ensure the operation of the Service, in accordance with these Terms, 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, including weekends and holidays (the service should be available at least 90% of the time per month), except as otherwise provided in the present Agreement.

finePrint.summary: A lifetime-deal buyer will not get money back if service issues are deemed the buyer's fault or a terms violation.

quote.text: The Executor does not bear the financial liability to the Client and does not return to the Client the money paid under the present Agreement if the Subscription Features were not accepted due to the fault of the Client, in particular, due to a violation of these Terms.

trials.claim: Builds smart forms, high-converting quizzes, and booking flows without code
trials.claimQuote: Build Smart Forms, High-Converting Quizzes, and Booking Flows Without Code
trials.reasoning: The vendor directly states forms, quizzes and calculators can be built with zero code, and that the same designer builds quizzes and booking forms. Optional CSS and confusing terminology do not show code is required to build them.

exhibits.quote: You can add your own CSS and match the form to the site.
exhibits.argument: Full design matching requires writing CSS code, which undermines the promise of building without code.

exhibits.quote: because some of the terminology had me scratching my head like I was trying to decipher an ancient scroll.
exhibits.argument: A buyer reports confusing terminology and frustration, undermining that non-technical users can build without code.

exhibits.quote: Build forms, quizzes, and calculators with zero code
exhibits.argument: Vendor states the builder creates forms, quizzes and calculators with zero code.

exhibits.quote: The same form designer also builds quizzes, surveys, booking forms and calculators.
exhibits.argument: Vendor confirms the same designer builds quizzes and booking forms.

trials.claim: Replaces separate form, quiz, booking and calculator tools with one builder
trials.claimQuote: FormDesigner replaces them with one no-code builder, powered by conditional logic and AI
trials.reasoning: The exhibits only show form features in one builder and one buyer replacing a form builder. They do not show separate quiz, booking and calculator tools all being replaced.

exhibits.quote: It doesn't have a lot of integrations, but it has the option to use an url or embed it
exhibits.argument: Buyer admits limited native integrations, undermining that one builder replaces separate tools.

exhibits.quote: Logic, payments, autosave, webhooks and integrations: everything a form needs is set up in the same visual builder.
exhibits.argument: Vendor states everything is set up in the same visual builder.

exhibits.quote: It completely replaced the limited form builder in my email tool, which has been a big upgrade.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms FormDesigner replaced their limited form builder.

trials.claim: All-in-one data collection ecosystem vs basic form builders
trials.claimQuote: Unlike basic form builders that only handle simple text inputs, FormDesigner is an all-in-one data collection ecosystem.
trials.reasoning: The vendor lists logic, payments, autosave, webhooks and integrations in one builder, and a buyer confirms complex forms with intensive conditional logic and automation. Limited integrations in one review and the uptime term do not materially contradict that broader feature set.

exhibits.quote: It doesn't have a lot of integrations, but it has the option to use an url or embed it
exhibits.argument: Buyer admits limited integrations, directly contradicting the all-in-one ecosystem claim.

exhibits.quote: the service should be available at least 90% of the time per month
exhibits.argument: Terms allow significant downtime, undermining reliability expected of an all-in-one data collection ecosystem.

exhibits.quote: Logic, payments, autosave, webhooks and integrations: everything a form needs is set up in the same visual builder.
exhibits.argument: Vendor describes an all-in-one setup covering logic, payments, autosave, webhooks and integrations.

exhibits.quote: Nothing came close to Jotform as far as building complex forms with intensive conditional logic, field, and email automation until FormDesigner.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms it handles complex forms with intensive conditional logic and automation beyond basic inputs.
